subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the ZSD-420 across its X-Type X400 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The ZSD-420 is a single-application engine for us — the Jaguar X-Type 2.2D, produced from 2008 to 2010.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, and timing chain components where required. EGR valve and cooler, DPF components, turbocharger, high-pressure fuel pump, and injectors are all inspected and measured.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: EGR valve clogging is common on higher-mileage examples. Injector seal problems are also common. DPF clogging can occur with short-trip or urban use.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed ZSD-420 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR ZSD-420 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, and timing chain components where required. EGR valve and cooler, DPF components, turbocharger, high-pressure fuel pump, and injectors are all inspected and measured.

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
